basic_details.job_title: Zila Panchayat Mungeli Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Programme Officer & Accountant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Zila Panchayat Mungeli has notified 3 contract vacancies for Programme Officer (Vikas Bharat-ji Ram ji) and Accountant (Vikas Bharat-ji Ram ji) posts under recruitment 2026. Applicants must apply offline by sending the completed application form through Registered Post or Speed Post to the Office of the Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat, Mungeli on or before 6 November 2026, as per advertisement number 1057/VB-G RAM G/Esth/Recruitment-1/2026-27. Qualification requirements differ by post, with the Programme Officer requiring a First class Master's degree in Rural Technology and Management

age_limit.details: Candidates must be between 21 and 40 years of age as of 01-01-2026. The upper age limit is 45 years for government servants, corporation/board/contract employees, and municipal soldiers as per Chhattisgarh government rules. content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Mungeli Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: Programme Officer and Accountant (Vikas Bharat-ji Ram ji)
Post-graduate / B.Com as per post requirements

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be sent by registered post or speed post to the following postal address: Office of the Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat, Mungeli, Chhattisgarh, PIN Code 495334 Candidates must clearly write the name of the applied post on top of the envelope. Enclose two self-addressed envelopes with Rs. 10 postage stamps affixed on each. Separate applications must be submitted for each post if applying for more than one.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Programme Officer: First division in M.A. / M.Sc. / B.E. / MRTM (Master of Rural Technology and Management) / Mathematics / Physics postgraduate degree. Additional weightage points are awarded for higher educational qualifications, computer practical test performance, and work experience in government rural development schemes at equivalent or higher pay scales (minimum 1 to 2 years up to more than 5 years). Accountant: 55% marks in B.Com (50% for SC/ST and second division graduates from Bastar and Sarguja divisions). Additional weightage is provided for higher educational qualifications, computer practical test performance, and experience in government rural development schemes. Candidates must be between 21 and 40 years of age as of 01-01-2026. The upper age limit is 45 years for government servants, corporation/board/contract employees, and municipal soldiers as per Chhattisgarh government rules. Age relaxations apply to reserved categories (SC, ST, OBC, Ex-servicemen, and women) according to state government circulars. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of educational mark sheets and certificates Proof of date of birth and permanent residency certificate of Chhattisgarh issued by a competent authority Caste certificate and caste verification certificate from a competent authority Medical board disability certificate (if applicable) Experience certificates from government rural development schemes with NOC from employer (if working in government/semi-government institutions) Two self-addressed envelopes with Rs. 10 postage stamps affixed

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process is based on merit prepared from minimum educational qualifications and work experience. For each post, 10 candidates per vacancy will be called for a skill test, following which the final selection list will be prepared. Equal marks will be resolved by giving preference to older candidates based on age.

faq.question: Q1. Is this recruitment for a permanent job or on contract?
faq.answer: This is a contract appointment initially for 1 year, extendable annually based on annual work progress reports and departmental requirements.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age relaxations?
faq.answer: Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes, Ex-servicemen, and women candidates are eligible for age relaxation as per Chhattisgarh government circulars.

faq.question: Q3. Can candidates apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates can apply for multiple posts, but a separate application must be submitted for each post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application submission?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent offline via Registered Post or Speed Post to the Office of the Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat, Mungeli.
